actions.action: Tap a branch over white paper to check for moving mites
Inspect leaf undersides with a magnifier or phone zoom
Test the spray on one leaf first
Spray undersides and stem joints indoors or in shade in the evening, every 5–7 days for 3–4 weeks, one product at a time
Give a lukewarm shower aimed at leaf undersides between sprays
Isolate the plant from other plants
Move the plant away from vents to reduce dry air
If mites persist after a month, release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus)
Alternatively, if mites persist, use a miticide

reason: The answer blames spray burn and lists mites only as a secondary possibility. Its spray cycle does target mites, and a miticide appears only as a late fallback, unlike the systemic that fixed it. It keeps mite treatment going, so it is not harmful.
